annotations.title: What job seekers are searching for, by role and place

description: What job seekers are searching for, by role and place. For "how many people are looking for care jobs in Leeds?" or "what are people searching for in Bristol?". Anonymous weekly counts of searches on Job Spotter by role words and place over the last 8 weeks, with the listings people found per search. Leave out what to get the most searched roles in a place (with a rising or falling trend), or where to get the places a role is searched most. For a role, it also gives the easiest places to find openings: where each search finds the most listings. A group is shown only when it holds 10 or more searches.
